technicalLines: 4x USB 3.0 device ports for connecting peripheral devices
High-speed data transfer rates up to USB Superspeed 5Gbps
Professional design allows for mounting under a table or behind a display
Fully backwards compatible with USB 2.0 devices
Simple plug and play design with no drivers required
Pair with the EX-100-USB3 for long distance USB extension/expansion
Pair with WyreStorm presentation switchers such as the SW-510-TX or <https://www.wyrestorm.com/product/apo-210-uc/" style="color: #000000;">APO-210-UC for expanded connectivity
featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The USB-HUB4 is a simple add-on accessory for expanding USB connectivity of your devices. Pair this hub with a number of WyreStorm products to help build your full solution. Connect the hub to the CAB-UAOC-15 USB 3.0 extension cable to provide long distance transmission of high-speed USB 3.0. The USB-HUB4 is also a great companion to the Apollo line of unified communication solutions. Although simple, we’ve kept pro installations in mind by including a set of mounting brackets to easily install the hub under a desk or behind a display.
Mounting brackets are included in the box allowing the hub to easily be installed under a desk or behind a table to keep your installations looking tidy.
Professional design allows for mounting under a table or behind a display
Fully backwards compatible with USB 2.0 devices
